name: docstyle
description: Apply the Google developer documentation style guide when creating, editing, or auditing technical documentation. Edits files in place; --audit reports findings without edits. Ships the full guide (70 pages) as local references with a topic index. In Claude Code a SessionStart hook also applies the core rules, plus Polish style rules for Polish, to chat replies; /docstyle:docstyle on|off toggles it (default on).
